PLAN "12-Week Strength and Hypertrophy (Start 2026-06-01)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase compound lift strength"
  GOAL secondary hypertrophy:
    name "Improve body composition"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Hypertrophy Base" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds

          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
